research_notes.quranenc: Official site currently reports 80+ languages, 100M+ beneficiaries, translations, tafsir, audio and downloadable/API formats.
research_notes.quranic_arabic_corpus: Useful for machine-readable morphology, syntax and ontology; never replace the authoritative Quran text with generated/OCR text.
research_notes.ksu: Useful as a primary institutional discovery lane for Arabic, translations, tafsir, recitations and Warsh; the project itself identifies source relationships including King Fahd Complex and Tanzil.
research_notes.apps: Applications are source/discovery surfaces, not automatic redistribution licences. Resolve the underlying publisher/source and item-level terms before storing or republishing files.
research_notes.manuscripts: For Quran manuscripts, complete digital surrogates/images are authoritative acquisition targets; OCR is search/index assistance only.
